subject: MediaCloud PO requirements + vendor registration (Coupa) and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@mediacloud.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@mediacloud.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: PO format + vendor registration steps for Redwood integration

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday — we are ready to move Redwood through our AP onboarding so we can start paying against the upcoming PO. To keep things moving quickly, please review the checklist below and upload the items into our Coupa vendor portal (link attached).

Required for vendor setup and PO processing:
- Completed vendor registration in Coupa (portal link below)
- Official invoice remittance address (must match vendor record)
- Bank details (IBAN/BIC for EU wires) + remittance email for AP confirmations
- EU VAT number (if registered) or completed VAT self-cert if not registered
- EORI (for cross-border goods/services where applicable)
- Copy of W-8/W-9 if you have US entity activity (we can advise on which one applies)

PO specifics: please populate the MediaCloud PO template (attached) with the following fields when submitting invoices: PO number, PO line number, item description, quantity, unit price, currency, and our line-level GL code (optional but preferred). Our default payment terms for this program are Net 60 unless otherwise negotiated in the PO.

Other notes: we sometimes issue split POs for multi-deliverable contracts — can Redwood accept invoices that reference a split PO and provide separate invoices per PO line? Also, we require a sample test invoice prior to first payment for automation verification.

Attached: MediaCloud_PO_Template.xlsx
Coupa portal: https://coupa.mediacloud.com/vendor-onboard/req/12345

If you can get the registration and the test invoice into the portal by end of next week (Aug 22), we should be able to include Redwood on the Sep payment cycle.

Thanks,
Sanjay (AP Ops)
Sanjay Patel
Accounts Payable — MediaCloud Solutions

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@mediacloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: PO format + vendor registration steps for Redwood integration

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear checklist and the portal link. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Naomi (finance) so we can coordinate internally.

Action items from Redwood side:
- Ben will confirm whether split-PO invoicing is acceptable operationally and whether we can (a) emit separate invoices per PO line and (b) include your GL codes on line items.
- Naomi will prepare our bank details, VAT/EORI proof (if available), and a sample test invoice for upload.
- I will start the Coupa vendor registration this afternoon; note that the portal wants a primary remit email and a remit address field — can you confirm the remit address to use if the PO billing address differs? Also, are you able to accept invoices in EUR and GBP (we may invoice in the PO currency)?

Couple of clarifying questions that would help speed things up:
1) If Redwood is not VAT-registered in the EU, do you accept the vendor self-certification form instead of an EU VAT ID?
2) For the test invoice, do you require a specific PO number format (we can put TEST-0001) or should we wait until you issue the live PO?

Attached: MC_Coupa_Onboarding_Instructions.pdf (we saved a copy of the portal steps)

We aim to have everything uploaded by Aug 20 and will send the test invoice once the vendor record is accepted.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@mediacloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: PO format + vendor registration steps for Redwood integration

Quick note from Sales Ops: we can accept split PO invoicing and will produce separate invoices per PO line if MediaCloud requires it. A couple of operational asks:
- Please confirm whether MediaCloud expects separate invoice PDFs per PO line or a single PDF with multiple invoice numbers (we can do either).
- If your AR system requires a DocuSign for the Master Services Agreement execution before payments, please share the envelope link so legal can sign.

Estimated timeline from our side: register in Coupa today; Naomi will upload bank/VAT; test invoice uploaded Aug 20; expected first live invoice after you issue PO (aim Sep payment run).

Ben
Senior Account Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@mediacloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@mediacloud.com
Date: 2026-08-17T14:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: PO format + vendor registration steps for Redwood integration

Ben / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few answers:
- Either a single PDF with multiple invoice reference lines or separate PDFs per PO line is fine, but our automation prefers one invoice per PDF when there are split POs.
- We will accept a test invoice with "TEST-0001" as the reference, but please include an explanatory note in the invoice body that it is a test for automation only.
- VAT: if Redwood does not have an EU VAT number, we will accept the vendor self-cert (there's a checkbox during Coupa registration) but note that without VAT we cannot perform reverse-charge treatment automatically — that is on MediaCloud to reconcile.
- Remit address: please use the remit address listed in the portal once your vendor record is created; if you need an override, route that request to ap@mediacloud.com with a signed banking attestation.

Attached the vendor request form we pre-populated with a few fields — upload that back into Coupa and it speeds review.

Attached: Vendor_Onboard_Request_12345.pdf

Sanjay
Accounts Payable — MediaCloud Solutions
